name: Edward
source:
Lily's childhood friend
Until two years ago, he often accompanied Lily, but now he has been promoted to a royal knight and lives in a dormitory in the castle town. As a result, he doesn't get to see me very often.
He is kind and sincere.
He seems to have a lot of thoughts about Tesla, who lives with Lily...
